rule.bounded:
At the start there are some discs on the table, at most {{maxDiscs}}, each either red or blue. The current player has four possible moves:
• Remove 1 or 2 blue discs from the table.
• Flip 1 or 2 red discs to blue.
The player who cannot move loses.
rule.generic:
At the start there are some red or blue discs on the table. The current player has four possible moves:
• Remove 1 or 2 blue discs from the table.
• Flip 1 or 2 red discs to blue.
The player who cannot move loses.

step: Click the rightmost or second-to-last blue disc to remove 1 or 2 blue discs, or do the same with red discs to flip 1 or 2 of them to blue.
